sections.content: Use es *necesario* *que*, es *importante* que and *hace* *falta* que with the subjunctive to discuss preparation for future changes.

items.spanish: Es necesario que preparemos las ciudades.
items.english: It is necessary that we prepare the cities.

items.spanish: Es importante que aprendamos nuevas habilidades.
items.english: It is important that we learn new skills.

items.spanish: Hace falta que las instituciones ofrezcan formación continua.
items.english: It is necessary that institutions offer continuous training.

sections.content: English can say 'it's necessary that society prepares' with barely a verb change — Spanish can't skip the subjunctive here: es *necesario* *que* *preparemos*, never que preparamos.
